baseline.method: Author RUScal full fit on measured 4140 frequencies; method reference, no physical truth

metric_definitions.moduli_absolute_error: independent per component absolute difference in GPa
metric_definitions.frequency_absolute_error: maximum absolute error across all76 ordered theoretical frequencies, MHz
metric_definitions.observation_rms_percent: 100*sqrt(sum(w*(fobs/fpred-1)^2)/count_nonzero(w)); correspondences recovered from monotone minimum-cost matching

reference_precision: Native rusio prints six decimals Mbar; fitted native frequencies print seven decimals MHz. Nonzero boundaries exceed printing precision and validated continuous numerical variation, without image metrics on two scalar moduli.
